questions.prompt: Which of the following commands creates a DataFrame with columns 'A' and 'B' containing integers 1-3 and 4-6 respectively?
questions.explanation: Option a constructs a DataFrame with two columns 'A' and 'B' and the specified integer values.

questions.prompt: Given df = pd.DataFrame({'x':[1,2,3,4], 'y':[10,20,30,40]}), which expression selects rows where x>2?
questions.explanation: df['x'] > 2 returns a boolean mask that keeps only rows with x greater than 2.

questions.prompt: Which code correctly computes the mean of column 'y' grouped by 'x'?
questions.explanation: groupby on 'x' followed by mean on 'y' gives the desired grouped means.

questions.prompt: Which of the following correctly adds a 1D array [1,2,3] to a 2D array [[10,20,30],[40,50,60]] using broadcasting?
questions.explanation: Broadcasting adds the 1D array to each row of the 2D array.
